title: OSF Settings Test Mod
description: Interactive v1 acceptance. Start with Read all values and Show test counters. Intentional failures are labeled TEST. See Docs/OSFSettingsTestMod/README.md.

Start here.label: Read all values
Start here.hint: Shows the actual values read by this separate native consumer.

Start here.label: Show test counters
Start here.hint: Session-only callback, save, action and launcher counts. Counts restart with the game.

Start here.label: Inspect public registry
Start here.hint: Checks this page is visible through the public registry API.

Value editors.label: Text and Unicode
Value editors.hint: Try typing, save, cancel, focus loss, empty text and restart. Maximum 128 UTF-8 bytes.

Value editors.label: Eight-byte text limit
Value editors.hint: Try nine ASCII characters and multi-byte text. Limit is bytes, not characters.

Value editors.label: Restart-required notice
Value editors.hint: This fixture tests the notice only; it has no gameplay effect.

Value editors.label: A deliberately long setting label to check clipping, selection and large-text layout
Value editors.hint:
Long help text for wrapping and scrolling.
The second line should remain readable at normal and large text sizes.

Value editors.label: Check invalid API writes
Value editors.hint: Attempts out-of-range, bad enum, overlong string and wrong-type writes; expects rejection.

Value editors.label: Reset this test page
Value editors.hint: Resets only this schema's values. Native Controls and provider persistence remain separate.
Value editors.confirmation: Reset the static test page to its defaults?

Input and subscriptions.label: Observed keyboard / mouse key
Input and subscriptions.hint: Assign a key, close all menus and press it. Expect one HUD notification per press; gameplay input is not consumed.

Input and subscriptions.label: Keyboard binding that cannot be cleared
Input and subscriptions.hint: No handler: tests capture and allowUnbound=false. This value does not create a native Controls action.

Input and subscriptions.label: Toggle key observer
Input and subscriptions.hint: Starts ON. Turn off, press in gameplay and confirm the counter stays unchanged.

Input and subscriptions.label: Toggle native value subscription
Input and subscriptions.hint: Starts ON. Turn off and edit a value; native change counter must stop.

Input and subscriptions.label: Block hotkeys for 10 seconds
Input and subscriptions.hint: Close Settings immediately. Native/Papyrus hotkeys and key observers must be suppressed until the HUD release message.

Native actions.label: Confirmed action
Native actions.hint: Cancel first, then confirm. Cancellation must not increment the action count.

Native actions.label: EXPECTED TEST: failed action
Native actions.hint: Displays an intentional failure without changing gameplay.

Native actions.label: Deferred success (3 seconds)
Native actions.hint: Wait with menu open; repeat and close the menu before completion.

Native actions.label: Duplicate completion rejection
Native actions.hint: First completion succeeds; second must log a nonzero status.

Runtime provider.label: Register / restore runtime provider
Runtime provider.hint: A second page named OSF Test - Runtime provider appears. Re-register after removal to load saved values.

Runtime provider.label: Replace provider definition
Runtime provider.hint: Adds one field while preserving existing valid current values.

Runtime provider.label: Toggle intentional provider save failure
Runtime provider.hint: Starts OFF. Turn ON, attempt an edit on provider page, expect failure and old value. Turn OFF to recover.

Mod Issues.label: Report test warning and errors
Mod Issues.hint: Adds warning, long error details and an issue from a mod without a settings page.

Mod Issues.label: Replace warning with error
Mod Issues.hint: Same ID must update in place and clear old detail fields.

Mod Issues.label: Clear native test issues
Mod Issues.hint: Clears only this fixture's native reports.

Launchers.label: Toggle launcher availability
Launchers.hint: Enables/disables the TEST: toggle availability card. Other cards cover native, callback, delay, rejection and timeout.

Papyrus.label: Papyrus alias status
Papyrus.hint: Set by the quest alias. After loading a save, expect Ready. If needed use Initialize below, close Settings, then reopen.

Papyrus.label: Initialize / re-register Papyrus fixture
Papyrus.hint: Requires OSFSettingsTestMod.esm enabled. Useful for existing saves. Close Settings to let script setup run.

Papyrus.label: Papyrus alias immediate action
Papyrus.hint: Bound alias callback should complete and update status.

Papyrus.label: Papyrus Global deferred action
Papyrus.hint: Global callback completes after a 3-second menu-aware wait.

Papyrus.label: Papyrus typed read/write check
Papyrus.hint: Writes known bool/int/float/enum/string values; validates reads; check Native readback afterward.
Papyrus.confirmation: Replace the test values with the Papyrus test values?

Papyrus.label: Papyrus reset check
Papyrus.hint: Resets test value 'enabled' through the Papyrus API.

Papyrus.label: Papyrus report issue
Papyrus.hint: Reports an intentional warning through the script API.

inventory.title: TEST: schema -> Inventory
inventory.description: Opens the game's existing Inventory menu through a schema launcher.

missing.title: TEST: unavailable native menu
missing.description: Must remain unavailable because this menu is deliberately not registered.
